Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries

Class PatientContactTransactions

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.PatientContactTransactions
public class PatientContactTransactions extends Object
This class contains all functionalities to
  • confirm patient contact at ELGA KBS with e-Card and without e-Card

    • Contact confirmations are a proof of a treatment contact between a health care provider and a patient.

    • Method Details

      • registerConfirmationContact

        public static Object registerConfirmationContact(AssertionType hcpAssertion, String samlTicket, String cardToken, org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier patientId, int kindOfRequest) throws UnauthorizedException
        This method initiates confirmation of patient contact. Therefore HCP-Assertion has to be in Security Header. This method distinguishes how patient contact should be confirmed. There are two possible options with e-Card and without e-Card. If the confirmation of patient contact is performed with e-Card, an identity assertion of the patient must be included in SOAP body. Otherwise, the patient's bPK must be transmitted.
        Parameters:
        hcpAssertion - assertion that authenticate health care provider who confirm patient contact
        samlTicket - identity assertion of patient
        cardToken - card token of used e-Card
        patientId - ID of patient (bPk or social security number)
        kindOfRequest - kind of requests (VO, eMedication, eImmunization, electronic records)
        Returns:
        true if the contact could be registered and false if contact could not be registered. If error was thrown Message with error details is returned.
        Throws:
        UnauthorizedException - the unauthorized exception
